description: The drowned layer — underwater POIs are a province acceptance criterion and the catalogue has drowned/submerged place families to feed. Reef and bed flora (coral at three scales, seaweed, algae, kelp, driftwood, water rock-grass) from Depths of Skyrim with the 174995 corrected meshes, its wreck family (Atmoran longship/rowboat/warship, Bretic carrack half-wrecks) for sunken structures, and SIRENROOT's free-standing broken/hollow ruin blocks and WALKABLE rubble floors, which give a submerged ruin a swimmable, standable interior. Culture-neutral: wrecks and reefs belong to no building culture, so this kit may be combined with any settlement kit at a shoreline. Depths of Skyrim's large WRECK HULLS are not here: they are places, not scatter, and they live in `wrecks-v1` for 16g/16h to plot. What this kit takes from Depths is its reef and bed flora plus the two small broken rowboat halves, which are dressing-scale sunken debris. 2026-09-16 pass: `tbp_seaweed06var1` added (the palettes already asked for it and the kit lacked it, so every instance of it resolved to nothing); vanilla `clam01`/`clamlarge01`/`clamthin01` for shell beds, `shipwreckboards01-03` for waterline debris, `kelpshortstatic01`/`kelptallstatic01` for the kelp forest; `dos/misc/dugupground` dropped (it is Depths' dig-site marker, not bed dressing). `tbp_seaweed01`/`02` stay: at 29.3 m and 42.7 m they are giant-kelp columns, and Bethesda's own mine places them at 8-70 m of depth at scale 0.15-1.15, so the palette uses them small and deep rather than at native size. Phase 11 Part 6 sourcing gap FILLED: a sunken Argonian shrine (Lilmoth's drowned quarter, the shrine to Xhon-Mehl the Fisher) had no focal object that reads Argonian - the mud kit's `sithisshrine` is the wrong Argonian culture for Murkmire, and everything else we hold is Imperial or Daedric. HTBM's xanmeer ruin ornament supplies it: `totem02` (0.40 x 0.49 x 2.07 m) is a standing carved totem, `totem03` (1.11 x 1.29 x 1.56 m) the squat altar-height idol block, `runicstone` (1.19 x 0.65 x 1.14 m) the inscribed marker, and `serpentsigilstatue` (1.38 x 0.44 x 0.63 m) the serpent-sigil plaque. All four carry the mod's own `architecture/xanmeer` textures, i.e. they are the Argonian ruin set rather than pieces borrowed from elsewhere - HTBM's `statuegoddess` and `totem01` were REJECTED for exactly that reason (they carry `here there be monsters - the call of cthulhu` textures, a different culture), and `serpentsigilstone` was rejected as a 0.14 m decal, too small to be a focal object. All four are opaque stone, so they survive submersion with no alpha/foliage problems. The same four are the right dry-land shrine dressing for `settlement-stilt-v1`.
